jobs.title: CSPTCL / CSP Companies AE & JE 2026: 368 Engineer Posts (152 AE, 216 JE)
jobs.summary: Chhattisgarh State Power Companies (CSPTCL, CSPDCL, CSPGCL) have notified 152 Assistant Engineer and 216 Junior Engineer posts, along with DEO, Attendant and other posts. B.E./B.Tech holders can apply for AE, and diploma or degree holders with Chhattisgarh domicile for JE; the last date is extended to 3 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: AE - 4-year B.E./B.Tech/AMIE in the branch; JE - 3-year diploma or B.E./B.Tech in the branch (JE for CG domicile only)
Age: as on 01-01-2026 - AE CG domicile 21-40 (UR male), up to 45 (UR female/SC/ST/OBC), other states 21-30; JE 18-40 (UR male), up to 45
Pay: AE pay matrix O-1 Rs 56,100 - 1,44,300; JE pay matrix S-8 Rs 35,400 - 1,12,400
Fee: UR Rs 800, OBC Rs 700, SC/ST Rs 600
Selection: Online CBT (100 MCQ, 2 hours, -0.25 per wrong answer); AE also document verification and 10-mark interview
Dates: apply online 6 Nov - 3 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM, extended)

jobs.title: VVCMC Recruitment 2026: 156 Group C Posts incl. 59 Junior Engineer
jobs.summary: Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation has notified 156 Group C posts in 18 cadres, including 59 Junior Engineer posts (Civil 50, Electrical 7, Mechanical 2). Engineering degree holders can apply for JE without experience; apply online by 17 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: JE - degree in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical (or Automobile) Engineering, or diploma + 3 years relevant experience; knowledge of Marathi required
Age: as on 01-11-2026 - 18 to 38 (open), 43 (backward class & orphan), 45 (PwD)
Pay: JE pay level S-14, Rs 38,600 - 1,22,800
Fee: Open Rs 1,000; reserved/EWS/PwD/orphan Rs 900; ex-servicemen nil
Selection: Online exam (2 hours) and document verification; no interview for Group C
Dates: apply online 26 Nov - 17 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM)

jobs.title: CSIR-NML Jamshedpur Apprentice 2026: 18 Graduate & Technician Apprentice Seats
jobs.summary: CSIR-National Metallurgical Laboratory, Jamshedpur will engage 7 Graduate (B.E./B.Tech) and 11 Technician (Diploma) Apprentices for 12 months through a walk-in interview on 16 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: regular B.E./B.Tech or 3-year diploma (Chemical, Metallurgy, Mechanical, CSE/IT) passed 2022-2026; verified NATS ID and APAAR ID; no earlier apprenticeship
Age: graduate 21-26, technician 18-24 on the interview date; SC/ST +5, OBC +3, PwBD +10
Stipend: Rs 12,300 per month (graduate), Rs 10,900 per month (diploma)
Selection: walk-in interview at CSIR-NML, Burmamines, Jamshedpur
Dates: walk-in 16 Dec 2026 from 9:30 AM (no entry after 11:00 AM)
